_note: Which document types form a chain, and the role each plays (docs/DESIGN.md, 'Chains'). 'base' is an original instrument, 'restatement' replaces everything before it, 'amendment' changes the base. A codicil amends a will the way an amendment amends a trust. Types not listed (other_dispositive, notices, accountings) are never chained. 'reference_words' says which words in a referenced instrument's description make it a missing amendment of this family.
